-- POLICY_SPEC: Managers approve refunds <= 10000 INR; Directors approve > 10000 INR within same org_id
CREATE TABLE public.refund_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id UUID NOT NULL,
    required_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    approval_limit_inr INT NOT NULL,
    refund_amount_inr INT NOT NULL
);
